page_title: BOL 0-1 INT | Bologna v Inter 09/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle. Matteo Darmian (Inter) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90+6' The game is interrupted now, Marko Arnautovic (Inter) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+5' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul.
90+3' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Inter.
90+1' Santiago Castro (Bologna) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Luca Pairetto signals. Inter are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
90' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Bologna force a corner. They send men into the box.
89' The free kick is delivered by Nikola Moro (Bologna) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
89' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul. Bologna win a free kick.
87' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) commits a foul and Luca Pairetto immediately signals a free kick. Inter are awarded the free kick.

85' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.

85' Fine play by Dan Ndoye (Bologna) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Inter.
81' Davy Klaassen (Inter) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
80' Nicolo Barella comes off the pitch to be replaced by Davy Klaassen (Inter).
80' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Joshua Zirkzee is replaced by Santiago Castro (Bologna).
80' Substitution. Jens Odgaard walks off the pitch and Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) comes on as a substitute.
78' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.

78' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Yann Sommer pulls off a brilliant save.
77' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) is penalised for a foul. Luca Pairetto had a clear view and blows his whistle.
77' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
77' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) works the corner short.
76' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee blows his whistle, Bologna are awarded a corner kick.

74' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
74' It is time for a substitution. Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is on for Alexis Saelemaekers.
73' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Bologna get a free kick.
69' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Nikola Moro (Bologna) replaces Michel Aebischer.
69' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
66' Substitution. Marcus Thuram is replaced by Marko Arnautovic (Inter).
66' Davide Frattesi (Inter) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
64' A pass from Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) is intercepted by Yann Sommer and the move breaks down.
62' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul after Remo Freuler (Bologna) hacks down one of his opponents. Inter are awarded a free kick.
61' Simone Inzaghi has decided to substitute Hakan Calhanoglu and he is replaced by Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Davide Frattesi (Inter) will replace Henrikh Mkhitaryan.
60' Stefan Posch (Bologna) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
58' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) probably handled the ball. A free kick to Bologna.
57' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
56' The players claim that Alexis Sanchez (Inter) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right. Bologna have a free kick.
56' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
56' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Bologna have a corner.
51' Dangerous play by Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna). Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
50' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
49' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) commits a rough foul. Luca Pairetto stops the game and makes a call. Bologna will take a free kick near the side line.
48' Stefan Posch (Bologna) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
47' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Remo Freuler (Bologna), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
47' Remo Freuler (Bologna) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. It's a free kick to Inter in a dangerous position.
46' Simone Inzaghi makes a switch. Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is coming on in place of Carlos Augusto at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Inter are ruled offside.
45+2' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
45+1' A dangerous looking corner kick from Alexis Sanchez (Inter) is cleared to safety by the defence.
45+1' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45+1' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Now Inter have a corner.
44' Stefan Posch (Bologna) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Luca Pairetto saw the whole situation. Inter have been awarded a free kick.
43' Marcus Thuram (Inter) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.

42' The game is interrupted. Yann Bisseck (Inter) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. A free kick has been awarded to Bologna.
40' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Inter.
39' A player from Bologna commits a rough challenge. Luca Pairetto blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick is awarded to Inter.

37' 0 - 1 Alessandro Bastoni displays his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross deep into the box. Yann Bisseck (Inter) gets onto the scoresheet by superbly heading it into the top right corner – 0:1.
36' A pass from Nicolo Barella (Inter) is intercepted by Lukasz Skorupski and the move breaks down.
35' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.
34' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the right post and forces a good save out of Yann Sommer.
33' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) makes a rough challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul. Inter will take a free kick.
33' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
30' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Inter, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
30' Inter keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
28' The foul by Sam Beukema (Bologna) was seen by Luca Pairetto who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Inter earn a free kick.
26' Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Bologna.
25' Luca Pairetto shows the yellow card to Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) for a heavy challenge.
23' Bologna fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
22' Carlos Augusto (Inter) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Lukasz Skorupski is alert and denies him.
22' Nicolo Barella (Inter) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the right post. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!

20' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Yann Sommer shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
18' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
18' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
18' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The ball goes out for a corner. Bologna can continue in their attacking effort.
17' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Inter will have a goal kick.

15' Matteo Darmian (Inter) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
12' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Luca Pairetto no option but to blow his whistle.
10' Lukasz Skorupski pulls off a great save to deny Alexis Sanchez (Inter), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
8' Marcus Thuram (Inter) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
5' Alexis Sanchez (Inter) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Bologna will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Luca Pairetto.
